newsitem.title: FRANCE: GTM-Entrepose unit wins British airport contract.
newsitem.headline: GTM-Entrepose unit wins British airport contract.

text.p: Dumez-GTM, a unit of French construction group GTM-Entrepose, said on Wednesday that it and British company Miller were selected by BAA to conduct underground work for a planned extension of London's Heathrow airport.
In a statement, Dumez-GTM put its share of the contract at an estimated 100 million stg.
Plans to build a fith terminal at Heathrow will allow the airport to raise passenger handling capacity to 80 million per year from the current 50 millions.
The project, which requires BAA to invest over one billion stg, is subject to a public inquiry. If accepted, work on the project would end by 2002.
